description: This Java source file defines the OrderServiceClient class, which serves as an I/O adapter for communicating with the order-service. It provides a method to create orders by making HTTP POST requests via Spring's WebClient, handling exceptions, and logging errors. The class utilizes configuration properties for base URL and timeout settings, and encapsulates a custom runtime exception.

classes.name: OrderServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the order-service API, primarily to create orders, handling HTTP communication, exceptions, and logging.

classes.name: OrderServiceClient.OrderServiceClientException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception class used for wrapping errors encountered during communication with the order-service.

methods.name: OrderServiceClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebClient with base URL and timeout settings from configuration properties.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order by sending a POST request to the order-service API, propagating the caller's bearer token, and handling errors.
